ground_truth_draft.expected_behavior: forget_permits must preserve the CLOSED (LSB) bit in the CAS write. Previously `new << PERMIT_SHIFT` wrote 0 to LSB, silently reopening a closed semaphore. Fix ORs `curr_bits & Self::CLOSED` into the new value so closed state is sticky across forget.
ground_truth_draft.rationale_from_pr_metadata: PR title 'fix(semaphore): Fix semaphore reopens after forget' and body: 'Current forget_semaphores doesn't consider LSB ... which is used to store semaphore open or closed, which leads to a weird behavior that semaphore reopens. Solution: sets the closed bit on forget_semaphores.' Closes #8020. Approved by Darksonn; labeled M-sync, R-loom-sync. New tests forget_closed/add_permits_closed assert is_closed() after forget on a closed semaphore.
